name: seller wins
description: Everything delivered per the criteria; complaint is a colour preference not in the SOW.

sow.title: Portfolio website for Lena Ortiz Photography

deliverables.title: Gallery page
acceptanceCriteria: At least 30 photos shown in a responsive grid
Clicking a photo opens it full-screen in a lightbox

deliverables.title: About page
acceptanceCriteria: Shows the bio text and portrait photo supplied by the client

deliverables.title: Booking form
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form emails the photographer
The form includes a preferred-date field

deliveryNotes: Seller: delivered gallery (34 photos, lightbox), about page with the supplied bio and portrait, and the booking form with a date picker. Site is live on the agreed domain.
complaint: I don't like the dark grey colour scheme. I wanted something warm, like beige, and the font feels cold. I want my money back.
evidenceNotes: E1 gallery.png: 34 photos in a grid that reflows on mobile. E2 lightbox.mp4: clicking any photo opens it full-screen. E3 about.png: bio and portrait match the files the client sent. E4 booking-test.mp4: form with a date field submitted; the photographer's inbox received the email within a minute. E5 client-brief.pdf: the original brief does not mention colours or fonts.
